strings.name: Hayao Miyazaki
strings.summary: Hayao Miyazaki builds hand-drawn worlds that combine everyday detail with fantasy, exploring war, nature, growing up and work. With Isao Takahata and colleagues, he established Studio Ghibli. My Neighbor Totoro, Princess Mononoke and Spirited Away helped expand Japanese animation’s international reach. These films emerged from sustained collaboration rather than solitary production.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected chronology extends to 2026-03-17. This is not a complete catalogue of works or appearances; later plans are not treated as completed events.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Ghibli and directed Spirited Away and other works, using animation to explore ecology, peace and growing up.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Graduated from Gakushuin University in 1963, studying politics and economics
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Building an animation studio
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Co-founded Ghibli with Takahata and colleagues, developing animated features for international audiences.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Two animated-feature Oscars
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Spirited Away and The Boy and the Heron received the animated-feature award.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Panorama boxes unveiled
strings.timeline.event-1.text: A Ghibli press event displayed his illustrated boxes; Toshio Suzuki described his continuing creative work.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: The Boy and the Heron won an Oscar
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Shared the animated-feature award with producer Toshio Suzuki.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Released The Boy and the Heron
strings.timeline.event-3.text: The new animated feature opened in Japan, marking another return to feature directing.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Released The Wind Rises
strings.timeline.event-4.text: A story centered on an aircraft designer examined creative aspirations and the reality of war.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Spirited Away won an Oscar
strings.timeline.event-5.text: The film released in 2001 received the animated-feature award.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Released Princess Mononoke
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Conflict between people and nature broadened the themes and audience of animated cinema.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Released My Neighbor Totoro
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Rural life and childhood imagination shaped its widely recognized characters.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Co-founded Studio Ghibli
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Built a continuing animation production base with Takahata and colleagues.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Released Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Adapted his serialized manga into an animated film.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Directed his first animated feature
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Completed The Castle of Cagliostro, part of the Lupin III series.
strings.timeline.event-11.title: Joined Toei Animation after graduation
strings.timeline.event-11.text: Finished university and entered professional animation production.
strings.timeline.event-12.title: Born in Tokyo
strings.timeline.event-12.text: Grew up in Japan and developed an interest in manga before working in animation.
